capabilities.title: Username OSINT across 3000+ sites: check profile existence and extract public metadata
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Maigret core: username search across a curated 3000+ site database
capabilities.reason: Nexus RECON has bounded coordinate lookup and repository intelligence, but a username OSINT multi-site sweep is not implemented.

capabilities.title: Structured person report: aggregate findings into a profile with confidence levels
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Maigret report output: HTML, PDF, JSON, CSV with cross-platform evidence
capabilities.reason: Nexus RECON does not yet produce structured person intelligence reports.

capabilities.title: Site database: maintained JSON definitions for 3000+ platforms with check patterns
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Maigret sites.json: curated platform definitions updated by community
capabilities.reason: A maintained site check database for RECON username enumeration is not yet implemented in Nexus.

capabilities.title: Recursive username extraction: find linked usernames on discovered profiles
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Maigret recursive mode: follow aliases found on profile pages

capabilities.title: Route OSINT requests through proxy chains for operational security
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Maigret proxy support: SOCKS5, HTTP proxy chains
capabilities.reason: Nexus does not yet route RECON requests through proxy chains; anonymity routing for OSINT pending.

capabilities.title: Paid OSINT data broker integration
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Maigret optional paid OSINT API integrations
capabilities.reason: Nexus is BYOK free; paid OSINT data broker subscriptions are excluded.
